threshold_selection_method: Validation set optimization for target sensitivity >= 0.85
known_limitations: Trained on PhysioNet 2019 ICU data; external generalizability not yet validated.
Data has high baseline missingness imputed via median values.
Longitudinal risk predictions require careful calibration.
intended_use: Clinical decision-support tool for monitoring sepsis risk in adult ICU patients.
out_of_scope_use: Not for standalone autonomous diagnosis or treatment decision making.
Not validated for pediatric or neonatal populations.
